definitions.explanation: In Christianity, the third person of the Trinity, together with the Father and the Son. A central concept in Christian theology.

examples.japanese: {聖霊|せいれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{導|みちび}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: To believe in the guidance of the Holy Spirit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{聖霊|せいれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{御名|みな}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧。
examples.english: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

examples.japanese: {聖霊|せいれい}{降臨|こうりん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦キリスト{教|きょう}→キリスト教：10823_kirisutokyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The descent of the Holy Spirit is considered an important event in Christianity.

notes:
USAGE:
A Christian theological term. Part of the Trinity ({三位一体|さんみいったい}): ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧ (Father), ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (Son), and {聖霊|せいれい} (Holy Spirit). {聖霊|せいれい}{降臨|こうりん} refers to the Day of Pentecost.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聖霊|せいれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧ (the work of the Holy Spirit)
- {聖霊|せいれい}{降臨|こうりん} (descent of the Holy Spirit; Pentecost)
- {聖霊|せいれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive the Holy Spirit)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{精霊|せいれい}→精霊：13820_seirei⟧: spirit, soul of the deceased — a homophone with a different meaning; refers to spirits of the dead or nature spirits
